status: source register only — not a category-wide MOQ table
rule: An Alibaba MOQ can populate the independent-site SKU only when alibaba_listing_title, alibaba_product_url, material, configuration and unit all match the independent-site SKU. A category match or a visually similar product is not enough. Bind an entry with the product fields alibaba_listing_key + alibaba_moq_verified_date + moq_display_mode = published_verified; until then the SKU renders the MOQ fallback answer.
note: Alibaba public MOQ is a commercial listing parameter. Before it is shown on the independent site, the owner must confirm that it remains commercially acceptable for the same current SKU, configuration and order route.
